messages.text: Ronaldo punished over Portugal walkout with fine he can pay off in 39 seconds

metadata.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has been suspended for 30 days and fined £215 over his walkout from the Portugal national team following an explosive fallout with head coach Jorge Jesus.
metadata.content: Cristiano Ronaldo: Portugal captain punished over walkout following explosive row with head coach Jorge Jesus | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Cristiano Ronaldo: Portugal captain punished over walkout following explosive row with head coach Jorge Jesus Portugal captain Cristiano Ronaldo claimed head coach Jorge Jesus twice broke his word about the star's role in the team after he walked out on the national team's camp on the eve of a match; he has now been punished for his actions but will not miss any Portugal matches Monday 19 October 2026 20:37, UK Image: Cristiano Ronaldo has made 234 appearances for Portugal Cristiano Ronaldo has been suspended for 30 days and fined £215 over his walkout from the Portugal national team following an explosive fallout with head coach Jorge Jesus. The Portuguese FA's disciplinary council did not specify when Ronaldo's ban begins, but Sky Sports News understands it is enforced from the date he left the squad's training camp in Denmark on September 30. It means the 41-year-old former Manchester United and Real Madrid star is available to play in Portugal's Nations League matches next month against Denmark and Wales if he is called upon by Jesus. Ronaldo accused Jesus of broken promises and a "breach of trust" over his involvement in the team . The new head coach denied there had been any agreement. messages.text: Sage under increasing pressure at Crystal Palace

metadata.summary: Crystal Palace have no immediate plans to change their manager - but Pierre Sage is under increasing pressure following their 5-0 thrashing at Brighton on Sunday.
metadata.content: Crystal Palace manager Pierre Sage under increasing pressure after 5-0 defeat to Brighton | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Crystal Palace manager Pierre Sage under increasing pressure after 5-0 defeat to Brighton Former Lyon and Lens boss Pierre Sage was appointed Crystal Palace manager after Oliver Glasner left in the summer; the 47-year-old has won four of his 10 games in charge in all competitions; Palace lost 5-0 to rivals Brighton on Sunday By Chris Reidy and James Savundra Monday 19 October 2026 18:23, UK Image: Crystal Palace manager Pierre Sage is under increasing pressure at Selhurst Park Crystal Palace have no immediate plans to change their manager - but Pierre Sage is under increasing pressure following their 5-0 thrashing at Brighton on Sunday. Palace find themselves 14th with seven points from seven games and Sage was unable to give assurances he had the club's full support after such a bitter defeat to their rivals. Chairman Steve Parish recently stated the club was on "high alert" during the transitionary process from the era of Oliver Glasner into the new one under Sage, which includes a number of new players and a first Europa League campaign. metadata.summary: Toto Wolff believes in-form Red Bull will be a central part of the "full-on fight" he is expecting at the front of the Formula 1 field into 2027.
metadata.content: F1: Toto Wolff says Max Verstappen, Red Bull resurgence adds to expectation of 'full-on fight' into 2027 season | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content F1: Toto Wolff says Max Verstappen, Red Bull resurgence adds to expectation of 'full-on fight' into 2027 season Mercedes are fast closing on a world championship double, but Red Bull are threatening to end the 2026 season with F1's fastest car after back-to-back wins for Max Verstappen; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin from Friday evening, live on Sky Sports F1 Monday 19 October 2026 16:23, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player On the Sky Sports F1 Show podcast, Bernie Collins praised Red Bull and their strategy after Max Verstappen's clean sweep in Singapore Toto Wolff believes in-form Red Bull will be a central part of the "full-on fight" he is expecting at the front of the Formula 1 field into 2027. Wolff's Mercedes team are closing in on a world championship double heading into the closing races of this season, with Kimi Antonelli able to clinch the drivers' title as early as this weekend's United States Grand Prix if results go his way. The strength of Mercedes' challenge in both championship races was built on a flying start to the season - which has been the first of the sport's new regulation era - with eight wins from the campaign's first 10 rounds. messages.text: Brook wants to be captain 'England fans can rely on'

metadata.summary: Harry Brook insists he wants to be a captain that "England fans and the team rely on" as we near the one-year anniversary of his altercation with a bouncer at a nightclub in New Zealand.
metadata.content: Harry Brook wants to be captain 'England fans can rely on', ODI skipper says ahead of Pakistan, Sri Lanka tri-series | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Harry Brook wants to be captain 'England fans can rely on', ODI skipper says ahead of Pakistan, Sri Lanka tri-series Harry Brook on nightclub incident in New Zealand last year: "I know it wasn't an ideal situation to put myself in, but I feel as a captain and a leader I've learnt a lot"; England's tri-series ODI vs Pakistan, live on Sky Sports Cricket, 8.30am, Tuesday (first ball 9am) Monday 19 October 2026 12:48, UK Image: Harry Brook says he wants to be a captain that 'England fans can rely on' Harry Brook insists he wants to be a captain that "England fans and the team rely on" as we near the one-year anniversary of his altercation with a bouncer at a nightclub in New Zealand. Brook was overlooked for the Test captaincy after Ben Stokes' international retirement this summer, while he's previously admitted that he could have been sacked as white-ball skipper for the incident in Wellington that occured just hours before an ODI against the Black Caps on Halloween last year. Since then, Brook has stabilised an ailing 50-over side, with England winning their last three series - having lost seven of eight prior - while his T20 team currently top the world rankings.
